## Invitations

A total of 2363 invitations were issued during the outreach activity. Attendance was recorded for 842 people, giving an attendance rate of 35.6 per cent. These figures provide the overall position for invitations issued and participation recorded. They will support routine review of the outreach activity and help maintain a clear record of the response to invitations.

The attendance figure is reported alongside the number invited so that participation can be considered in context. No further interpretation of the figures is included in this report.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 2002 invitees. A further 2002 reminders were sent as part of the contact activity. The use of both messages and reminders provided a consistent approach to communicating with invitees.

Staff continue to phone people who missed two appointments. This contact remains part of the follow-up activity and complements the SMS and reminder messages. The figures above record the messages and reminders issued, while telephone follow-up continues separately.

Prepared by G. Evans.
